info.name: Export Items (v3) API
info.description:
This API enables you to perform the following:
- Retrieve a list of accounting entries that have been exported to the external ERP/accounting system.
- Create a new export job event.
- Retrieve a list of existing export jobs and create a new one.
- Retrieve details of an export job.
- Retrieve a list of export job items and update their information.

Contact Support:
 Email: apiteam@pleo.io

request.description:
An export item = an accounting entry transformed into an exportable entry. The accounting and bookkeeping information is collected from an accounting entry to form an export item.

• A request to this endpoint retrieves a list of export items selected for export.

• Please note that you can retrieve a list of export items only from `pending` and `in_progress` export jobs.

response.name: Export Items retrieved successfully.
